title: Smaller Than Expected
text: Smaller Than Expected. This is a case of "look at the measurements."  First off, these seem deeper than most of my drawers, so I can only use them in the bottom drawers.  Second, the dividers seems to impede my ability to put a lot of clothes in the drawer, so I took them out.  I'll be considering what else I might use it for, but for now, I wish I had paid more attention to the sizes before I picked it out.
